chapter: Trombone technique, plunger mute and the California years
title: Frankie Newton and his homemade mute
summary: He played with Frankie Newton before Heywood, and recalls Newton's homemade mute full of holes.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Growl, plunger and derby: the trumpet mute tradition

blocks.x: Was Frankie Newton still up there then?
Because you had played with him earlier, didn't you.
I played with Frankie before then with Eddie Heywood.
He had a mute that was interesting. He had a buzz mute...
Yeah. Well, he made it himself, you know. It had a whole lot of holes and things in it. I don't know what he had inside of it. He might have had some dollar bills in there rattling.
